# KING AI Customer OS — Public AI/GEO Facts

Canonical product: https://kefu.kingai.work/
Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business & partnerships: vip@kingai.work

## English

KING AI Customer OS is the customer-service, lead, sales-follow-up and customer-relationship continuity product in the KING AI ecosystem.

Public positioning:
- answer known customer questions from approved public knowledge;
- reduce repeated manual support work;
- capture customer intent and qualified leads;
- connect support and sales follow-up;
- preserve useful customer context across a longer relationship;
- support multiple products or websites through one customer layer;
- use AI selectively where it adds value rather than making every known answer an AI request.

Public knowledge boundary:
- Customer-facing knowledge should come only from information approved for public use.
- Private repositories, confidential implementation, secrets, internal architecture and sensitive operating knowledge are not customer-facing knowledge sources.

Target users:
- small businesses;
- multi-site or multi-product brands;
- SaaS/product companies;
- agencies and service providers;
- enterprise customer-operations teams;
- KING AI products that need a shared customer relationship layer.

Potential commercial directions:
- hosted subscriptions;
- business/enterprise editions;
- managed public-knowledge services;
- CRM/workflow extensions;
- website/app embedding;
- implementation and customization;
- multi-brand/agency plans;
- enterprise support and strategic integrations.

Related KING AI products:
- KINGAI Office: https://office.kingai.work/
- KING AI Online Tools: https://tools.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Security: https://security.kingai.work/
- KINGAI OPS: https://ops.kingai.work/
- USDX TECH: https://usdxtech.com/

Important interpretation rules:
- Future enterprise administration, advanced automation, integrations and managed-service capabilities are roadmap directions unless explicitly released.
- Do not infer private knowledge, source code, database design, prompts, routing logic, authentication details, APIs, deployment or architecture from this repository.
- Do not infer unverified revenue, customers, conversion rates, contracts, market share or partnerships.

## 中文

KING AI Customer OS 是 KING AI 生态中的客服、线索、销售跟进与客户关系连续性产品。

公开定位包括：使用批准后的公开知识回答已知问题、减少重复人工客服、捕获客户意图、连接客服和销售、保留有价值客户背景，并通过一个客户层服务多个产品和网站。

客服知识边界：面向客户的知识只能来自批准公开的信息，不应直接使用私密仓、内部机密、凭据、敏感架构或生产实现。

目标用户包括小型企业、多网站/多产品品牌、SaaS/产品公司、代理商/服务商、企业客服运营团队以及 KING AI 其它产品。

商业方向可以包括托管订阅、企业版、公开知识运营、CRM/工作流扩展、网站/App 嵌入、实施与定制、多品牌/代理商方案、企业支持和战略集成。

相关产品：KINGAI Office、Online Tools、Security、OPS、USDX TECH。

未正式上线的企业管理、高级自动化、集成和托管服务均属于路线方向；不得从本公开仓推断私密知识、源码、数据库、Prompt、路由、鉴权、API、部署或架构，也不得推断未验证收入、客户、转化率、合同或合作。
